franchise: Z.H.P. Unlosing Ranger VS Darkdeath Evilman
summary: A standalone Nippon Ichi tactical roguelite revived on Switch and PC through Prinny Presents NIS Classics Volume 2.

entries.title: Z.H.P. Unlosing Ranger VS Darkdeath Evilman
entries.definitive_edition: Standalone PC / NIS Classics Volume 2 release

emulation.notes: Use PC for the main run.

primary.version: Standalone PC / NIS Classics Volume 2 release
primary.why: The 2022 Windows release is the highest-fidelity and cleanest capture route for the former PSP-only tactical roguelite.
primary.how_to_play: Play the standalone Steam/PC release; use PSP only for original-version comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern rerelease of a PSP-era game, not a ground-up remake.
